name: WdConstants
description: This enumeration groups together constants used with various Microsoft Word methods.

constants.name: wdForward
constants.description: Indicates that selection will be extended forward using the MoveStartUntil or MoveStartWhile method of the Range or Selection object.

constants.name: wdBackward
constants.description: Indicates that selection will be extended backward using the MoveStartUntil or MoveStartWhile method of the Range or Selection object.

constants.name: wdAutoPosition
constants.description: Represents the Auto value for the specified setting.

constants.name: wdFirst
constants.description: Represents the first item in a collection.

constants.name: wdCreatorCode
constants.description: Represents the creator code for objects created by Microsoft Word.
